run_screen_command.english: Drive a review or staging action owned by the user's app screen.

run_script.english: Run a bundled script from the current skill's scripts/ folder.

run_sql_query.english: Run ONE read-only SQL SELECT against this app's own database, for questions the other tools cannot express (joins, distributions, 'which X appears in both A…

save_to_documents.english: Keep something in the user's Documents: an artifact you made (a report, a chart) or a file they sent you in chat (a tax form, a policy…).

scan_intel.english: Run the market-intelligence scan now — fetches news/web context for the user's holdings + watchlist and upserts story-arc signals (the Intelligence tab feed).

search_connector_directory.english: Search the connectors the user can add in Connectors -> Browse & add: built-in ones and ready-made MCP servers (brokers, exchanges, accounting).

search_docs.english: Search the product documentation corpus (docs/product/) by keyword.

search_institutions.english: Search for a bank / financial institution to link, and find which provider can connect it.

search_past_conversations.english: Search the user's earlier conversations with you by keyword, when they refer to a previous chat and neither this conversation nor your memory covers it.

serper_fetch_page.english: Fetch and read the full text of a URL via Serper specifically — bypasses the active-provider selection.

serper_search.english: Search the web via Serper specifically — bypasses the active-provider selection, so this always hits Serper even if a different provider is currently active.

set_categories_color.english: Set the swatch colour for a category — shown on transaction chips and budget rows.

set_categories_hidden.english: Hide or unhide one or more categories from default pickable / budget views.

set_commitment_actions.english: Replace a commitment's actions/events — the dated checklist of NON-payment tasks: apply for a loan, sign a contract, confirm a counterparty transfer, verify…

set_commitment_installments.english: Replace the ENTIRE installment schedule of a commitment.

set_envelope_targets.english: Propose setting, snoozing, or clearing a funding TARGET on an envelope (basis for the '$X more needed' pill), stored PER ENVELOPE (one per merged envelope).

set_funding_plan.english: Replace a commitment's funding plan — the named sources that say HOW each installment gets paid.

set_home_budget_engine.english: Switch the book's HOME budget lens — the paradigm the Plan tab/Overview/reports default to.

set_instrument_constituents.english: Set (or clear) a fund's look-through breakdown so the X-ray can see inside it.

set_investment_theses.english: Write the user's investment thesis for one or more tickers: reason, what would break it (breaks_if), role and price levels.

set_news_sources_enabled.english: Enable/disable one or many news sources by id (see get_news_sources).

set_payees_autocategorize.english: Enable or disable the auto-category feature for one or many payees.

set_payees_default_category.english: Set or clear a default category for one transaction kind, on one or many payees at once.

set_payees_hidden.english: Show or hide one or many payees from the autocomplete suggestions in the transaction form.

set_payees_rules.english: Replace ALL renaming rules on one or many payees in one call.

set_plan_baseline.english: Store or clear the FIRE baseline override.

set_price_alerts.english: Create one or many price alerts on a ticker ('alert me when X hits Y', 'set a stop at 90', 'X drops 5% today' via kind='move').

set_provider_credentials.english: Store the api_key for a secondary AI provider (for per-conversation overrides).

set_recurring_status.english: Confirm or dismiss a DETECTED recurring stream, correcting the automatic detection.

set_transactions_cleared.english: Mark one or more transactions cleared or uncleared (cleared/reconcile flow) — i.e.

show_guide.english: Light up a control in the user's app to show them how to use it.

simplefin_fetch_transactions.english: Fetch SimpleFIN transactions for a date window (default: the provider's own 14-day lookback).

simplefin_get_status.english: Check the SimpleFIN connector: whether it's configured and enabled, and when it was last fetched.

simplefin_list_accounts.english: List the SimpleFIN accounts (balance, suggested account_type, linked_account_id or null) — no transactions.

simulate_cashflow.english: Run a forward cash flow projection with hypothetical income and/or expense values.

simulate_retirement.english: Run the retirement simulation: the SAME engine and random paths as Plan > Outlook, so the user's plan has ONE answer.

swap_review_canonical.english: Swap a pending match-review's canonical to one of its tied alternatives (F20).

tavily_fetch_page.english: Fetch and read the full text of a URL via Tavily specifically — bypasses the active-provider selection.

tavily_search.english: Search the web via Tavily specifically — bypasses the active-provider selection, so this always hits Tavily even if a different provider is currently active.

telegram_send_message.english: Send a message to the user's Telegram right now.

trace_transactions.english: Trace the provenance / audit history of one or more transactions: how each was created, and every edit or deletion since.

undo_lot_disposals.english: REVERSE a disposal (sell / transfer-out) — use this to remove a duplicate or mistaken sale from the realized history.

undo_vest.english: REVERSE a vest event — shows what will be undone before writing anything.

unlink_receipt.english: Remove the link between one receipt and one transaction.

update_accounts.english: Edit one or many existing accounts — name, institution (custodian grouping key), initial_balance, initial_balance_date, credit_limit, last_four, note, or arc…

update_action_status.english: Mark a property action as Done or Not Started.

update_asset.english: Patch an owned asset's IDENTITY fields — name, category, description, notes, cost, share, insurance, maturity date, or linked loan.

update_automations.english: Update one or more existing Automations, including their trigger or paused state.

update_commitment_actions.english: Patch ONE action/event on a commitment — typically mark it done, or fix its date/amount.

update_commitment_installments.english: Patch ONE installment row (fix a wrong amount/date/label, or mark it paid).

update_commitments.english: Patch a commitment's TOP-LEVEL fields — rename it, change its currency or kind, re-link the funded position/liability account, mark the whole commitment comp…

update_envelopes.english: Edit envelopes — each update sets any of name, color and note (note '' clears it; absent fields are unchanged).

update_funding_source.english: Patch ONE funding source on a commitment — mark it done once the money actually arrived (status='done'), fix its amount/date, or disable it (disabled=true) w…

update_goal.english: Update a savings goal — change its amount, deadline, current saved amount, linked accounts, category, priority, note, or mark it completed/cancelled (status).

update_instruments.english: Edit an existing instrument's record — the UPDATE half of the instrument pair (resolve_instruments fetches facts).

update_lots.english: Correct a recorded lot — its purchase date, quantity, unit cost, fees, kind or note — including a lot whose shares have been sold (sold lots are correctable).

update_model_config.english: Change which provider/model the assistant runs on.

update_monitoring_config.english: Update the monitoring schedule — how often prices are checked and news is scanned, crash-watch thresholds, news-spike tuning, the AI analysis on watched tick…

update_option.english: Edit option metadata (note, strategy_tag, collateral linkage, open_date).

update_plan_scenario.english: Replace the levers of an existing Outlook plan scenario.

update_positions.english: Move an existing position to another account (account_id/account_name).

update_price_alerts.english: Change one or many alerts' op/value/kind, note, label, name, or channels by id (get_alerts to find it).

update_run_task.english: Mark one task on this Automation run's list started, finished, or failed.

update_skill.english: Propose editing an existing skill (name, description, body, or enabled).

update_transactions.english: Update fields on one or many existing ledger entries.

update_watchlist_items.english: Update one or many watchlist items' settings — toggle news monitoring (monitor_news, also the per-ticker alert mute), label/note, (tickers) intent = the user…

update_watchlists.english: Update one or many watchlists' name, description, or order.

verify_statement_balance.english: Verify a statement import by checking that the net change of the imported transactions matches what the statement says.

webhook_send_message.english: Send a message to the user's configured webhook right now.

x_search.english: Search X (formerly Twitter) for social posts and chatter.

yahoo_get_price_history.english: Fetch historical price points FROM YAHOO FINANCE DIRECTLY for one ticker — no CoinGecko fallback.

yahoo_get_ticker_prices.english: Query Yahoo Finance DIRECTLY for one or more tickers — no CoinGecko fallback.

ynab_fetch_transactions.english: Fetch YNAB transactions for a date window (default: the provider's own 14-day lookback).

ynab_get_plan.english: Read one YNAB plan live: its accounts (type, on/off budget, closed, balance, cleared balance) and one month's budget — Ready to Assign, income, assigned and…

ynab_get_status.english: Check the YNAB connector: whether it's configured and enabled, and when it was last fetched.

ynab_list_accounts.english: List the YNAB accounts (balance, suggested account_type, linked_account_id or null) — no transactions.

ynab_list_plans.english: List the YNAB plans (budgets) the saved token can see: id, name and currency.
